Name: FriendshipWithoutTalk
Author: mayuntian
Description:
At the end of a day, all npc's you haven't talked to (only npc's that have established a friendship level greater than 0) will be set to talked to, which doesn't increase your friendship level with them, but prevents it from getting lower.

当一天的游戏结束时, 所有没有交谈过的npc(仅限于建立了好感大于0的npc)都会设置为已交谈, 这并不会增加你和他的好感度, 但可以防止好感度变低.


1.1.0:

Now your farm animals will be petted automatically at the beginning of each day(like Auto-Petter).

现在每天开始时会自动抚摸您的农场动物(就像自动抚摸机一样)
